Batch 35 authoring is complete: seven A items, three B items, both pages, manifests, coverage, proof contracts, dependency evidence, and notes are in place.

Ville’s proof now handles an unattained supremum through a lower threshold; the anytime-validity proof defines the transform for nonpositive versions of the process. The updated arguments are in [Ville’s inequality](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/thm-villes-inequality.md:61>) and [anytime validity](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/thm-anytime-validity.md:58>).

Scoped checks passed: precheck 7/7 proofs, proof layout 10 items/23 steps, contracts 10/10, rendercheck 12 files, focused depcheck 637 items/165 pages, content policy, coverage, and source fetch 7/7.

**Owner reconciliation remains.** Five owner-owned Step 1 records have stale hashes: Ville, the anytime-valid p-value definition, anytime validity, confidence-sequence inversion, and the data-dependent crossing example. A no-owner record attempt was refused with “Only the owner may resolve this record”; I left those records untouched. The run-wide item-level check also reports 18 mismatches outside batch 35, and the shared batch schedule is stale: batch 35 still computes to level 4 with prerequisites 2 and 8. Details are in the [batch notes](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/mathematical-statistics-foundations-37-batch-35.notes.md:38>).

I also found a batch-8 issue: its p-value-to-level-test theorem lacks the nonempty disjoint alternative required by its cited size definition. Batch 35 proves fixed-time superuniformity directly and removes the affected level-test claim; the proposed batch-8 repair is recorded in the notes.
